verdict.sentence: The threshold asks 61.54 hours a day; the channels produce 1.309. With both format levers at their documented levels it would be 4.124. To reach the threshold at a 4% click rate and the measured watch time, YouTube would have to serve 6,821 impressions a day where it serves 457. Impressions are chosen by YouTube's recommendation system from how viewers respond, so that is the honest distance: it is reach, not metadata.
